# MathJax 3.2.2

Unmodified files from the official npm package:
https://registry.npmjs.org/mathjax/-/mathjax-3.2.2.tgz

Includes `es5/tex-chtml-full.js`, `es5/output/chtml/fonts/woff-v2/` and `LICENSE`.
The `es5/` prefix is removed here. Full TeX bundle keeps document math local,
including fonts and commonly autoloaded TeX extensions. License: Apache-2.0.

Archive SHA-256: `1b9c0a1c44df864e915690558e72adb9cc5203360daefd385084ced3b6c64c09`.

When updating, replace these files together from the official package, retain
the license, update this record, and run the actual MathJax browser regressions.
